confirmed.claim: Financement : place potentiellement entièrement ou partiellement financée selon le besoin démontré
confirmed.quote: Receive an offer for a UWC placement, which may be fully or partially funded depending on demonstrated need

confirmed.quote: Over 80% of IBDP students selected by a UWC national committee receive full or partial financial support.

confirmed.claim: Éligibilité : âge de 16 à 18 ans à l’inscription
confirmed.quote: Applicants must be between 16 and 18 years old at the time of enrolment.

confirmed.quote: Applicants should be currently enrolled in, or have recently completed, “Seconde to Terminale”.

confirmed.quote: Be a citizen of Burkina Faso, Hold permanent residency in Burkina Faso.

confirmed.claim: Éligibilité : anglais, base seulement, maîtrise courante non exigée à la candidature
confirmed.quote: While fluency is not required at the time of application, applicants are advised to attain a basic proficiency in English

confirmed.claim: Éligibilité : une seule candidature UWC par année académique

confirmed.claim: Éligibilité : impact positif dans la communauté, résilience et adaptabilité
confirmed.quote: The resilience and adaptability needed for an international and rigorous residential educational experience.

confirmed.claim: Pièces : formulaire en ligne (informations personnelles, parcours, activités, motivations)
confirmed.quote: Completing an online application form with personal details, academic background, extracurricular activities, and motivations for applying to UWC.

confirmed.claim: Pièces : essais ou réponses courtes
confirmed.quote: Submitting essays or short responses to demonstrate critical thinking and commitment to UWC values.

confirmed.quote: Providing references from teachers, mentors, or community leaders.

confirmed.claim: Pièces : autorisation signée du parent ou tuteur légal

confirmed.quote: Through the UWC national committee (NC) in your country of residence or citizenship

confirmed.claim: Sélection : entretien de panel pour les candidats présélectionnés
confirmed.quote: Individual Interviews: A panel interview where applicants discuss their motivations, aspirations, and alignment with UWC’s values.
